caption: The drawing features a detailed depiction of a dress, shown from the front, occupying the central portion of the composition. The dress has short, puffed sleeves adorned with lace-like edging, and a wide, square neckline with similar decorative trim. Decorative patterns consisting of floral and leafy motifs, as well as wavy and scalloped lines, extend vertically down the front panel of the dress and along the hem, sleeves, and neckline. To the upper left of the dress, there is a small crown motif composed of dots and simple lines, situated above a horizontal arrangement of small geometric shapes. To the right of the dress, there is a horizontal arrangement of leaves and small flowers with a rounded, textured central element, resembling a floral spray or brooch. The entire composition is rendered in fine, light gray or black ink lines on an off-white or cream background, with no perceptible areas of color. The drawing style is highly linear and delicate, emphasizing detail and symmetry in the decorative embellishments.
title: Child's Dress
